limits: Reference-grounded newly drawn 2D reconstruction, not extracted original meshes, textures or retail animation. Absolute 1:1 fidelity is not certified.
Camouflage motif placement, unseen surfaces, exact mechanical weapon micro-details and authored CQC choreography remain interpreted. Target is closest visible original PS2 costume fidelity.
Sixteen distinct physical action roles per native facing; repeated temporal frames and a two-keypose walk do not create additional native drawings or a complete retail motion cycle.
Source PNG bytes remain unmodified. Renderer ownership clips alpha outlines; rendered antialiasing is not claimed byte-identical to every source pixel.
This approval covers source art and framing only. Actual menu changes, native loading, match projectile emissions, regressions, GitHub and Vercel publication still require their own checks.
